prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain performance while losing 2 kg for weight category competition in 5 days
prompt_inputs.restrictions: No dairy due to lactose intolerance

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
Total daily calories create modest deficit (~300-500 kcal below maintenance) suitable for gradual weight loss
All meals are dairy-free and avoid lactose-containing products
Meal plan prioritizes lean protein sources and maintains adequate carbohydrates for athletic performance
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport with weight categories (boxer or wrestler) requiring a lean meal plan that maintains performance while managing daily caloric deficit for weight management

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high-intensity endurance with carbohydrate loading for optimal performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one full day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks)
Macronutrient ratio emphasizes carbohydrates (55-65%), with adequate protein (1.2-1.6g per kg body weight) and moderate fat (20-30%)
Total daily caloric intake aligns with high-intensity endurance athlete needs (approximately 3000-3500 calories)
Plan is compact and concise (no more than 5-7 sentences per meal description)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading, with specific macronutrient ratios

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle recovery and strength gains with optimized protein distribution around weightlifting workout

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans 24 hours with 4-5 meals clearly scheduled
Protein distributed across meals (minimum 25g per meal, ~1.6-2.2g per kg bodyweight daily)
Pre-workout and post-workout meals strategically timed around training session
Compact format with concise meal descriptions (no lengthy recipes)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) focusing on muscle recovery with emphasis on protein distribution across meals and meal timing around workouts
